the concerned Cadre Controlling Authority certifying that the

2. The ACR/APAR for the last five(05) years duly certified (each page) by
the Competent Authority in the parent department alongwith latest
vigilance clearance report indicating the pending & settled disciplinary/
criminal cases and details of major/minor penalties if any imposed on
the candidate during last ten(10) years duly signed & stamped by the
Competent Authority (on the prescribed format: Annexure-II),

4. The complete application form through proper channel alongwith all
requisite documents of eligible candidate should reach in the Office of
the Architect, Architect Office, Sector-14, Panjab. University,
Chandigarh (through Registered/Speed post/by hand) only and not to
address it to any other authority, within fifteen(15) days from the
date of issuance of this Vacancy Circular i.e. on or before
10.08.2026(Monday) upto 04:00 p.m., alongwith soft copy of
application duly filled by candidate in PDF Format through
E-mail- architectpu14@gmail.com.
5. Incomnplete Application Forms or applications not in the prescribed
performa or those received after last date are liable to be rejected. The
applicant must ensure that he/she fulfils the minimum eligibility
conditions & only then apply within due date. The Panjab University
shall not be responsible for any kind of postal delay. In case, it is not
possible to send the application through proper channel before the last
date, an advance copy may be sent well before the last date of receipt
of application. However, the candidature shall be considered only upon
receipt of the applicationthrough the proper channel.
6. The Panjab University reserve the right to withdraw the
selection process at any stage without assigning reasons/
claim thereto. The candidate may visit the official website
(www.puchd.ac.in) on regular basis for further updates.
7. The candidates who apply for the post will not be allowed to withdraw
their candidature at later stage.
8. Internal candidates of Panjab University who are otherwise eligible
may also apply for the post through proper channel with all required
documents.
9. Applicants from Department/Organization not following Punjab pay
Scales, must submit comparative chart stating their equivalence with
Punjab pay-scales, duly certified by their employer.
10. Complete Advertisement Notice alongwith
prescribed formats
(Annexure-I & II) are available on the official website of Panjab
University i.e. https://jobs.puchd.ac.in.
